input.free_text_description: The system operates in the file management, scheduling domain. It serves API Consumer, Customer, System, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include async rest template apache config, file download, file upload. Core business data revolves around Message. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a API Consumer, I want to manage application configuration centrally, so that all services pick up the latest settings without redeployment.
As a API Consumer, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents as needed.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage async rest template apache config operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
